description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'PayGradeServiceTest' that tests the 'PayGradeService' class in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup of dependencies, mock object expectations, and multiple test methods validating various functionalities such as retrieving pay grades, currencies, pay periods, saving, deleting, and counting entities related to pay grades.

classes.name: PayGradeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PayGradeService functionalities in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of PayGradeService and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeDao
methods.description: Tests that getPayGradeDao returns an instance of PayGradeDao.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the pay grade list from the service, mocking the DAO interaction.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific pay grade by ID.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Tests fetching list of currencies associated with a pay grade.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific currency by currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: testGetPayPeriodArray
methods.description: Tests getting an array of pay periods, expecting normalized data.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeArray
methods.description: Tests getting an array of pay grades in normalized form.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyArray
methods.description: Tests getting an array of currencies in normalized form.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Tests counting of pay grade currencies.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the list of pay grade currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeletePayGrades
methods.description: Tests deletion of pay grades by ID.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed pay currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Tests counting of allowed pay currencies.
